stance: Consumer sentiment is recovering from a low base. UMich final rose to 51.5 in November from 48.0, with 1y inflation expectations down to 3.7% (from 4.7%) and 5y down to 3.3% (from 3.5%), easing the Fed anchoring concern. Conference Board 91.7 (unconfirmed). Ifo 90.6 in November (verified, 2 sources). Single-survey rebounds often fail to carry into spending. Low conviction, neutral lean on US consumer; a 5y reading back above 3.5% would revive the hawkish risk.
